description: What RPCS3 boots from the path an ES-DE entry hands it (#618): whole fixture machines in, the launchability verdict of each PS3 entry out — read the way RPCS3 d5213de6 boots a folder, an image or a file, with boots naming the file its loader is handed and the disc it mounts.

vectors.name: rpcs3-a-disc-dump-folder-boots-its-eboot-with-the-folder-as-the-disc
vectors.rationale: RPCS3 handed a folder takes PS3_GAME/USRDIR/EBOOT.BIN, the fourth of its fixed boot paths, and mounts the folder holding PS3_DISC.SFB — which opens with .SFB — as the disc: launchable, boots naming both.

vectors.name: rpcs3-a-disc-game-without-its-sfb-refuses
